# An agent reorders functions. parseHeader moves to the bottom of the file in
# v1 and back to the middle in v2. A moved block has no counterpart in the line
# map - the diff reports it deleted here and added there - so the primary path
# misses and the exact window hash is what finds it again.
#
# This is the only fixture that reaches tier 1 and tier 2. Both are the same
# lookup; near_window is what separates them, so the v1 move is deliberately
# further than 50 lines and the v2 move deliberately nearer.
n1 20 90 61
